statement: Pinned SDL3 HIDAPI treats an unparented left Joy-Con as a sideways mini-gamepad by default, mapping D-pad to face buttons and presenting rotated/inverted left-stick axes; when parented or with the vertical Joy-Con hint it maps the same raw button and stick fields to a D-pad hat and conventional left axes. It also rotates left sensor coordinates for mini mode and exposes left-specific sensors when parented.
